photos.name: Resplendent Quetzal

photos.name: Acorn Woodpecker
photos.description: This woodpecker seemed particularly intense.

photos.name: Blue-and-white Swallow
photos.description: This vocal blue-and-white swallow rested briefly on a wire before resuming its acrobatic flight.

photos.name: Sunbittern
photos.description: Sunbitterns have striking wing patterns—when you least expect it, they spread their wings to display dazzling colors and eye-like markings.

photos.name: Pacific Ocean
photos.description: A view of the Pacific Ocean near Dominical.

photos.name: Yellow-throated Toucan
photos.description: A yellow-throated toucan foraging for a meal.

photos.description: Palm tanagers

photos.name: Boat-billed Flycatcher
photos.description: Boat-billed Flycatcher—note its distinctively broad bill!

photos.name: Gray-capped Flycatcher
photos.description: While superficially similar to the Boat-billed Flycatcher, the Gray-capped Flycatcher has a noticeably smaller bill.

photos.name: Crowned Woodnymph
photos.description: This female Crowned Woodnymph buzzed about, moving from flower to flower.

photos.description: Crowned Woodnymph

photos.name: Video of White-crowned Parrots
photos.description: A flock of raucous White-crowned Parrots

photos.name: Mangrove Swallow
photos.description: Two bickering mangrove swallows

photos.name: Prothonotary Warbler
photos.description: The golden yellow of this Prothonotary Warbler stood out against the dark banks of the Sierpe River.

photos.name: Tropical Kingbird
photos.description: This Tropical Kingbird perched along the Sierpe River, sallying out to catch a midair meal.

photos.name: Southern Lapwing
photos.description: A flock of Southern Lapwings flew by and landed along the mudflats by the river.

photos.name: Little Blue Heron
photos.description: Nearby, a Little Blue Heron waded in search of a midday meal.

photos.name: Snowy Egret
photos.description: A Snowy Egret passed by, just where the Little Blue Heron had just been hunting.

photos.name: American Crocodile
photos.description: Not too far away, an American Crocodile just barely broke the surface of the water.

photos.name: Proboscis Bats
photos.description: We found a small colony of proboscis bats roosting on a tree.

photos.name: Scarlet Macaw
photos.description: Despite the gloomy clouds, the occasional Scarlet Macaw added a much-appreciated splash of color.

photos.name: Green Heron
photos.description: Meanwhile, in the shadows, a Green Heron hunted patiently.
